newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - TRADE SUSPENSIONS OF VILNIUS BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - TRADE SUSPENSIONS OF VILNIUS BOURSE.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that it has suspended the trade in ordinary shares of the following companies:
- Karige, from May 20, for three trading sessions because of the increased number of shares in the issue.
- Metalo Iranga, from May 20 for three trading sessions, due to its shareholders' meeting.
- Lithuanian Savings Bank, from May 23 to May 30, at issuers' request because of its shareholders' meeting.
- Kedainiu Biochemija, from May 23 to June 2, at issuers' request because of its shareholders' meeting.
- Vilniaus Vingis, from May 28 to June 2, at issuers' request because of its shareholders' meeting.
The bourse also said that its board decided to delist Anyksciu Varis ordinary shares from May 20 because the company was reorganised into a private company.
